use_case.name: Purchase Order ERP Record Extraction
use_case.description: Extract structured header and line-item data from customer purchase order PDFs and produce reviewer-verified ERP-compatible JSON records.

business_spec.current_process: Order-processing employees manually inspect customer purchase orders and enter header and line-item information into the ERP system.
pain_points: Manual data entry is slow and error-prone
Complex table layouts and multi-page rows increase transcription difficulty
Product code and unit omissions cause downstream ERP errors
No systematic verification step before ERP transfer
business_spec.proposed_solution: Automatically extract structured PO data using AI, present the result alongside confidence information and the original PDF for reviewer verification, and export an approved ERP-compatible JSON record.
input_artifacts: customer purchase order PDFs (native and scanned)
target_outputs: ERP-compatible structured JSON record per purchase order
success_criteria: Faster and more consistent ERP data preparation
Fewer manual transcription and omission errors
Every record is reviewer-verified before ERP transfer
risks: Loss of complex table structure during extraction
Missing rows that continue across pages
Alteration of product codes or leading zeros
Transferring an unreviewed record to the ERP
business_spec.poc_goal: Extract header and line-item fields from a sample purchase order PDF, produce structured JSON ready for reviewer verification, and confirm no fields are invented or garbled.

technical_spec.security_constraints: POs contain internal commercial information and customer/supplier identifiers. External model APIs are permitted. Local-only processing is not required.

field_descriptions.purchase_order_number: Customer's purchase order reference number. Preserve exactly as written, including leading zeros and alphanumeric characters.
field_descriptions.delivery_date: Requested delivery date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
field_descriptions.delivery_address: Full delivery address as written in the PO.
field_descriptions.vendor_number: Supplier or vendor identifier as written in the PO. Preserve leading zeros.
field_descriptions.line_items: List of ordered items, one entry per distinct line item.
field_descriptions.item_number: Line item sequence number or position identifier as written. Preserve leading zeros.
field_descriptions.article_code: Customer's article or product code. Preserve exactly, including leading zeros and alphanumeric format.
field_descriptions.dimensions: Dimensions of the ordered material (e.g. thickness x width x length) as written.
field_descriptions.material_grade: Material or alloy grade designation as written (e.g. EN AW-5083, S355J2).
field_descriptions.quantity: Ordered quantity as written, including numeric value and unit if present in the same cell.
field_descriptions.product_form: Physical form of the material. Must be one of: Flat, round, rectangular bar.
field_descriptions.standard_designation: Applicable material or product standard designation (e.g. EN 485-2). Null if absent.
field_descriptions.cut_length: Specific cut length requested by the customer. Null if absent.
field_descriptions.temper_or_condition: Material temper or delivery condition (e.g. H111, T6, annealed). Null if absent.
field_descriptions.hardness_hv: Required hardness in Vickers (HV). Numeric. Null if absent.
field_descriptions.min_bend_radius: Minimum bend radius requirement. Numeric. Null if absent.
field_descriptions.delivery_length_note: Free-text note about delivery length or cut tolerance. Null if absent.
field_descriptions.applicable_standard: Any additional applicable standard or specification reference. Null if absent.
field_descriptions.special_flags: Any special instructions, notes, or flags noted within the line item area. Null if absent.

target_output_spec.missing_value_policy: Optional fields: set to null when absent. Required fields: flag for human review when missing or uncertain.
validation_rules: product_form must be one of: Flat, round, rectangular bar
Do not invent or infer values not present in the source document
Preserve all alphanumeric identifiers exactly, including leading zeros
Do not merge distinct line items

assumptions.text: No formatted PDF report is required as an output for this PoC. The downloadable JSON is the only output artefact.
Extraction model defaults to gpt-5.4 with temperature 0.0 on Azure OpenAI, as no specific model or temperature was requested.
Stakeholders beyond order-processing employees and reviewers assumed to include procurement management. No other stakeholders were specified.

parameters.task: Extract a structured ERP purchase order record from the PDF, capturing header fields (purchase_order_number, delivery_date, delivery_address, vendor_number) and all line items (item_number, article_code, dimensions, material_grade, quantity, product_form, and optional material specification fields). Handle multi-page tables, merged headers, and rows split across pages.
parameters.additional_instructions: Preserve all alphanumeric identifiers — article codes, item numbers, vendor numbers, and product codes — exactly as written in the document, including leading zeros. Do not reformat, normalise, or truncate them. Delivery dates must be captured in DD/MM/YYYY format. The product_form field must be one of exactly: Flat, round, rectangular bar. Do not merge distinct line items. When a table row is continued on the next page, capture all continued rows as separate line items. Do not invent or infer any value not explicitly present in the source document.

steps.name: Send record and original PDF to reviewer
Reviewer inspects and approves or returns record
Notify employee of return with reviewer comments
Employee corrects extracted values or uploads corrected PO

traceability.required_by: input includes scanned PDFs with complex multi-page tables, merged headers, and rows split across pages; accuracy is critical
human_review=yes; pre-screens extraction quality before reviewer inspection
